testcase.name: an unparsable phase reads as Prepared()
a DIFFERENT unresolved attempt cannot claim the slot()
markPreRestoreBackupAvailable enables the flag and persists the original date()
recordAttemptCommitted on a free slot returns false()
beginAttempt rejects an attempt that is not Prepared()
an unparsable kind reads as Restore()
beginAttempt persists identity, kind, context and rollback path atomically()
a Rollback attempt round-trips with a null context()
resolveAttempt clears only for the owner()
pre-restore availability and the attempt journal are independent()
initial state has no attempt and no preserved backup()
re-claiming with the same id and no rollback path clears the stale path()
re-claiming with the same id is idempotent()
clearPreRestoreBackupAvailable disables the flag and clears the date()
only the synthetic legacy owner claims the legacy slot - the claim converts it atomically()
